boundary.description: From the junction of Egerton Road and Royle Street, E along Royle Street, Kingswood Road, Kingsway, Grangethorpe Road and Crossley Road to the Manchester – Stockport MBC boundary, then along this boundary, excluding all houses in Whitehurst Road) to Barcicroft Road and along Barcicroft Road and Westcroft Road, Parrs Wood Road and Egerton Road to its junction with Royle Street.
